title_en: Fall 2026 SNU Global Scholarship (GS2) Additional Recruitment
summary: International graduate degree-program students enrolled and studying at the university in Fall 2026 may apply for the SNU Global Scholarship II, a full tuition waiver for Fall 2026. Students must apply online themselves through MySNU (my.snu.ac.kr) between Monday, 9 November and Friday, 13 November 2026. Applicants should first read the attached English guide.
applies_to: International students in graduate degree programs at the university who are currently enrolled and studying in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기). Application is optional; the notice does not state any further limits.

dates.what: Online application period for the Fall 2026 GS2 additional recruitment, through MySNU
Semester covered by the scholarship (one semester; Fall 2026 tuition waived)

conditions: Only international graduate degree-program students enrolled and studying in Fall 2026 are eligible.
The scholarship covers one semester only, the Fall 2026 tuition.
Students must apply online themselves through MySNU (my.snu.ac.kr).
The number of recipients is not stated in the notice; it is shown only as ○○.

The Office of International Affairs makes the final selection, considering each college or graduate school's applications and review results and its available budget, so applying does not guarantee selection.
steps: Read the attached English guide, "(ENG) SNU Global Scholarship(GS) for Fall 2026 (Additional Recruitment).pdf" (the attachments were not read for this translation; download them from the original notice).
Log in to MySNU (my.snu.ac.kr) and submit the online application between 9 November and 13 November 2026 (the notice does not give the menu path).
translation:
Fall 2026 SNU Global Scholarship (GS2) Additional Recruitment

The university will select additional recipients of the Fall 2026 SNU Global Scholarship (GS2) [글로벌 초우수 장학금] as follows.

A. Eligible for recommendation: International students in graduate degree programs at the university (currently enrolled students studying in Fall 2026).

B. Support: Global Scholarship II (full tuition waiver) [the notice spells this "Global Scholarshop II"].
1) Benefit period: one semester (tuition waived for Fall 2026).
2) Number of recipients (planned): ○○ (number not stated).
※ The Office of International Affairs [국제처] will make the final decision, taking into account the applications and review results of each college or graduate school, the Office's available budget, and other factors.

D. Application period: Monday, 9 November 2026 to Friday, 13 November 2026.
※ Applicants apply online themselves through MySNU (my.snu.ac.kr).
※ See the attached English guide.

Attachments (2) [not read for this translation]:
- (ENG) SNU Global Scholarship(GS) for Fall 2026 (Additional Recruitment).pdf (350 KB)
- 2026학년도 2학기 글로벌 초우수 장학사업 추가 선발계획.pdf (Fall 2026 SNU Global Scholarship Program Additional Selection Plan, 92 KB)

Note: the original notice skips item C. For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
